name: Hermes Agent
_sections_note: Measured live against Hermes Agent v0.14.0 on 2026-06-15 via /api/cli/debug/hermes-cli. The OLD spec used `footer { anchor: '^[❯>]', anchor_last:true }` plus `modal { from_bottom:16, until:'footer' }` and `status { from_bottom:4, until:'footer' }`. That footer anchor ONLY matches the bare idle prompt line `❯`; in BUSY the prompt line renders as `⚕ ❯ msg=interrupt · ...` and in APPROVAL it renders as `⚠ ❯`, neither of which starts with ❯/>. When the footer anchor fails, evaluator.ts defaults the section to the whole screen (from=0), so every `until:'footer'` section clamps toLine = footer.fromLine = 0 and starves to ZERO lines. Measured proof at a live `⚠️  Dangerous Command` modal: status=generating (WRONG), sections[modal].text='' (0 lines), →approval condResult=FALSE — FSM stuck in busy. Fix mirrors the codex rewrite: `modal` self-anchors on its own landmark with no `until`; `body` is the whole screen; busy/idle/approval guards run against those self-contained sections. Every anchor string below was seen verbatim in live screen capture.

modal.anchor: ⚠️\s*Dangerous Command|Dangerous Command|Approval required|Permission required|Allow once|Allow for this session|Add to permanent allowlist|↑/↓ to select, Enter to confirm|Select a model|switch model|Model picker

_selfmatch_note: SPINNER-BODY-SELFMATCH fix (sibling of the claude-cli rc.6 status_tail anchoring). Hermes' busy cues (`msg=interrupt` / `Enter to interrupt` / `/steer` / `Ctrl+C cancel` / `musing...`) render on the bottom footer/status prompt line (`❯ msg=interrupt · ...` or `⚕ … │`). They used to be checked as unanchored literals against the whole-screen `body` section, so an assistant answer that quoted or explained those strings self-matched → idle→busy false-fired and busy→idle's not-clause read TRUE forever → infinite generating. The `status` anchor section only exists while the `⚕` status line is drawn; when it is absent the anchor fails and the section defaults to whole-screen (the very trap documented in _sections_note), so a not-clause scoped to `status` would still self-match at idle. The fix instead scopes every busy-cue check to a bounded bottom window `status_tail` (from_bottom:4 — the same status window the retired `status:{from_bottom:4}` used), which never falls back to whole-screen. See claude-cli/specs/4.0.json status_tail.

not.matches: Dangerous Command|Approval required|Permission required|Do you want to (?:proceed|allow|run|create|edit|delete|modify)|Allow once|Allow for this session|Add to permanent allowlist|Select a model|switch model|Model picker

source.session_query: SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE source = 'cli' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages m WHERE m.session_id = sessions.id) AND started_at >= ? - 2 ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
source.session_cluster_query: WITH RECURSIVE up(id) AS (SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE id = ? UNION SELECT s.parent_session_id FROM sessions s JOIN up ON s.id = up.id WHERE s.parent_session_id IS NOT NULL), cluster(id) AS (SELECT id FROM up UNION SELECT s.id FROM sessions s JOIN cluster ON s.parent_session_id = cluster.id) SELECT id FROM cluster
source.message_query: SELECT role, COALESCE(NULLIF(content, ''), tool_calls) AS content, CAST(timestamp * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS ts_ms FROM messages WHERE session_id = ? AND ((content IS NOT NULL AND content != '') OR (tool_calls IS NOT NULL AND tool_calls != '')) AND role IN ('user', 'assistant', 'system', 'tool') ORDER BY timestamp ASC, id ASC
